rule: the code a status keyword stands for
the code a kind keyword stands for
the order an unscoped read tries the scopes in
the structural climb follows at most MAX_DEPTH parent links
`>=` evaluates as `>=`
`!=` also matches a span lacking the key
a regex is anchored at both ends
a bare attribute is truthiness, not presence
`resource.service.name` is answered from the span column
`{A} > {B}`: B is a child of an A span
a sibling is not the span itself
a union form returns both participating sides
`>>` climbs past the first parent
a search returns at most LIMIT traces
a spanset carries at most SPSS spans
the traces come back newest first
a span lacking the `by()` key is grouped under `nil`
`| coalesce()` drops the key `by()` added
a bucket is labelled by the instant that closes it
the log2 bucket is the smallest power of two at or above the duration
`topk` keeps the largest series, `bottomk` the smallest
the exemplar is the bucket’s longest span
`compare()` keeps a value distinct per stored type
a root is a span with no parent id, never an orphan whose parent id names a span not stored
`childCount` counts the spans whose parent is this span
`trace:duration` is the whole trace’s extent
an event intrinsic asks whether ANY event satisfies it
a `\x` escape is the character with that hexadecimal code
a `\101` escape is the character with that octal code
`minInt` and `maxInt` are the signed 64-bit bounds
multiplication binds tighter than addition
`>>` is the descendant operator and `>` the child one
`error` is a status keyword, not an attribute name
`duration` is an intrinsic, not an attribute name
a millisecond is 10^6 nanoseconds
the groups come back in first-appearance order
`resource.service.name` is counted from the span’s own column
the resource scope is in `compare()`’s key universe
`kind` and `status` are counted as the keywords the API returns
`topN` is applied per key and per side, not as one cap
`with(exemplars=false)` turns the exemplar column off
`matched` is how many spans of the trace the query kept
the trace row carries the root service and the root name, in that order
`!= nil` is presence: the key is stored
`select()` adds a projected slot to each span tuple
`{A} && {B}` keeps only traces carrying both sides
an attribute `by()` group carries its stored type, so two values with the same label stay two groups
an array of two element types is missing
an array is the compact JSON text of its elements
an array value is not counted in `compare()`
each distinct array is its own `nil` series on the metrics routes
